topic_name: Introduction To Algorithms & Introduction To C
syllabus_context: Algorithms, Flowcharts, Structure of C program, Compilation and execution, Identifiers, Keywords, Basic data types.
Arithmetic, Relational, Logical, Bitwise, Assignment operators, Operator precedence and associativity, Type conversion.
if, if-else, nested if, switch-case, for loop, while loop, do-while loop, break, continue, goto.
Function declaration, definition, call, Parameter passing (call by value vs reference), Recursion, Pointer arithmetic, Pointers and arrays, Pointers to functions.
Structure definition, Declaration, Initialization, Accessing members, Nested structures, Array of structures, Structures and pointers, typedef.
Arithmetic, comparison, logical, identity, membership operators, if-elif-else, while loop, for loop with range, break, continue.
Lists, Tuples, Dictionaries, Sets, List comprehensions, Built-in methods, Function definitions, *args, **kwargs, Lambda functions.
Import statement, math, random, sys, os modules, File open, read, write, with statement, Exceptions (try-except-finally).
Dictionary comprehensions, Nested collections, Closures, Decorators, Generators, yield expressions, Recursion, Memoization.
Custom exceptions, Context managers, Serialization with json and pickle, Binary file processing, iterators and itertools.
Linear search, Binary search, Bubble sort, Selection sort, Insertion sort, Time and space complexity analysis.

topic_name: Linked List & List, Representation Of Linked List, Operations Of Linked List
syllabus_context: Singly linked lists, Doubly linked lists, Circular linked lists, Insertion, Deletion, Traversal, Reversal operations.
Binary trees, Binary search trees (BST), Tree traversals (Inorder, Preorder, Postorder, Level order), BST insertion, deletion.
Graph representations (Adjacency matrix vs list), BFS, DFS, Shortest path (Dijkstra), Hash tables, Hash functions, Collision resolution (Chaining, Open addressing).
AVL trees, Rotations, Balance factor, Red-Black tree properties, B-trees, Priority queues and Binary Heaps (Min/Max heap).

topic_name: Databases And Database Users & Database System Concepts And Architecture
syllabus_context: Database approach vs File systems, DBMS characteristics, Three-schema architecture, Data independence (Logical vs Physical), DDL, DML.

topic_name: Conceptual Data Modeling And Database Design
syllabus_context: Entity-Relationship (ER) model, Entity sets, Attributes, Relationships, Cardinality ratios, Weak entity sets, ER-to-Relational mapping.
SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, Aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG), INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, Subqueries.

topic_name: Normalization & Complex Queries, Triggers, Views & Basics Of Functional Dependencies And Normalization For Relational Databases
syllabus_context: Functional dependencies, 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF, Multivalued dependencies, Lossless-join decomposition, Dependency preservation.

topic_name: Transaction Processing & Introduction To Transaction Processing Concepts And Theory & Concurrency Control Techniques
syllabus_context: ACID properties, Serializability (Conflict vs View), Two-Phase Locking (2PL), Deadlock detection and prevention, Timestamp ordering.

topic_name: Introduction To Computer Networks And Internet
syllabus_context: Network edge, core, Packet switching vs Circuit switching, Delay, loss, throughput, Protocol layers (OSI 7-layer vs TCP/IP 4-layer).
HTTP, DNS, SMTP, Socket programming, Multiplexing, UDP vs TCP, Reliable data transfer principles, TCP 3-way handshake.
Forwarding vs Routing, IPv4 addressing, Subnetting, CIDR, NAT, ICMP, DHCP, Routing algorithms (Link-State vs Distance-Vector).

topic_name: The Link Layer And Local Area Networks
syllabus_context: Error detection (Parity, Checksum, CRC), Multiple access protocols (CSMA/CD, CSMA/CA), MAC addressing, ARP, Ethernet, VLANs.
TCP Congestion Control (Slow start, Congestion avoidance, Fast retransmit/recovery), Flow control (sliding window), ECN, QUIC.
OS functions, Dual-mode operation (User vs Kernel mode), System calls, Process concept, PCB, Process states, Context switching.
Critical-section problem, Peterson algorithm, Semaphores, Mutex locks, Deadlock conditions, Resource-allocation graphs.
Contiguous memory allocation, Paging, Page tables, Segmentation, Virtual memory, Demand paging, Page fault handling.
Disk structure, Disk scheduling algorithms (FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN, LOOK), Disk management, Swap-space management, RAID levels.
Bankers algorithm for deadlock avoidance, Deadlock detection and recovery, Classic synchronization problems (Dining Philosophers, Readers-Writers).
